title: Measure and dimension of transcendental parameter hairs
exact_target: Determine how large the parameter hairs are, in measure and Hausdorff dimension, for all three exponential, sine and cosine families.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300065 (AMR-052-0065). CC BY 4.0.
